reviews.author: Samantha Hembree
reviews.text: My car wouldn't start and we were thinking it was the starter. We called several places and this place had the most reasonable price and when I say reasonable I mean cut in half!!! Well let me tell you this is the most honest and honorable mechanic shop I have ever been to. What started as a starter replacement turned out to be the battery. We were for sure it was the starter but it wasnt. They could have easily taken advantage of us and chose to be honest. They didnt even charge for changing the battery. I will continue to be a repeat customer.

reviews.author: Tori McKinney
reviews.text: They quoted me $1400 at least for a "broken radiator & support" but another mechanic picked it up to find out it was just a hose leak. The other mechanic charged me about $179 & that included the tow & diagnostics. This place charged me almost $90 for a diagnostic fee which turned out to not be true anyways. I tried calling them to discuss & asked them to refund the diagnostic fee to which they didn't return my call. I will never trust them again.

reviews.author: Jimmy
reviews.text: Outstanding shop! My son had an emergency repair needed, towed the car there after a radiator hose failure. They were very fair with the repair cost and had the car ready the next day!

reviews.author: Logan Galloway
reviews.text: I recently had a ton of suspension work done here and they really brought next level service and helped me out during a tough time. Not only did they beat another quote that was offered to me by over $800 dollars, they hooked me up with four new tires and still able to beat the price by over $800. Barbara and the service staff really deserve recognition and praise for their hard work, and punctuality. OH and their work is warrantied! Truly the icing on the cake. I highly highly recommend.

reviews.author: Chris Houde
reviews.text: Very friendly and knowledgeable. They went above and beyond and were able to get everything taken care of despite my hectic schedule. Thank you guys!

reviews.author: Dave Goforth
reviews.text: Staff was really friendly on my truck purchased. Mechanic was more than helpful. He explained everything that they did to the vehicle and all the history they had with the vehicle. I received an excellent price for the truck. They told me if anything was wrong I could bring it back and they would make it right. I would highly recommend anyone buying a vehicle from this company.

reviews.author: Daniel DiBona
reviews.text: My family and I had an issue with our engine and its oil driving over the mountain roads. They were able to squeeze us in, check out the engine and the oil, and fix our issue within two hours of getting there. The service was fantastic and the person working the front desk was really friendly to my whole family.

reviews.author: Scott Anderson
reviews.text: On the way to work car started shaking and check engine light was flashing, seemed certain I had a serious misfire going on. Usual shop did not want to touch it as the spark plugs were known to break on this model and they advised me to go to the dealership. Closest dealership gets horrific reviews, almost entirely 1-star, and I had a bad feeling about going there so I took the chance on BM Auto at the recommendation of a friend. They informed me that yes indeed one of the spark plugs was bad and very, very stuck and they would put their best mechanic on it but I should hope for the best (extraction and replacement in the hundreds) and expect the worst (engine disassembly and rebuild or possible replacement in the mid to high thousands). Nathan spent ALL DAY slowly and carefully working the stuck spark plug out, determined to help me avoid an engine disassembly. After 2/3 of the way out it indeed broke, but he kept at it, carefully using the extractor to work it out while maintaining the integrity of the engine threads. When I walked in to pick it up they immediately told me how incredibly lucky I had gotten, and Nathan showed me the broken spark plug and informed me it was one of the most difficult to remove of his 25-year career and he was keeping it as a memento. I am so incredibly grateful for his hard work and dedication to helping me avoid a massive charge and amount of work. If I had gone to the dealership it is almost certain they would have been selling me a new engine or car, and this is only a 2018 with 150k miles on it and plenty of life to go. While I still love my main shop I have used for years out of simple loyalty, I would highly recommend Black Mountain Automotive, they, and specifically Nathan, SAVED my car and had it back to me for hundreds of dollars in two days.

reviews.author: Amy Mclaughlin
reviews.text: I can't say enough great things about this shop. Fast, efficient, caring and very well priced! 10/10 they truly go above and beyond to make sure car is safe and reliable. They got me in fast and replaced my air compressor, charged my AC and did my oil change all within a day. Caleb and Barbara are the best! I truly thank you all and will definitely be back with any car needs I have!

reviews.author: Noelle Ewing
reviews.text: Do not go here for anything other than tires!! They misdiagnosed My vehicle cost me twice as much money and time had to pay for a rental and bring my truck to 2 other places. was definitely frustrating and I feel like could’ve been avoided. Maybe it was just my situation but I would definitely use them as a second or third opinion or maybe once you know exactly what’s wrong.. Nice people ro worth with tho for sure.

reviews.author: Michael Woodlief
reviews.text: Took my 2014 Honda CRV in for what I thought was a timing chain noise and they found out it was a bad drive belt tensioner. very honest shop!!! Even the dealership said I needed a new chain. My CRV is as was the day I bought it. IF YOU WANT AN HONEST SHOP TAKE YOUR CAR TO THEM. THERE THE BEST!!!

reviews.author: janet h
reviews.text: I thought my car needed ball bearings replaced. Barbara at the front desk was very helpful, patient, and professional. It turned out that I only needed a new tire and wheel alignment. Their pricing was reasonable and they did a great job in a timely manner, and honest estimates. Highly recommend this place.

reviews.author: Erin Carr
reviews.text: The customer service is super amiable. All of the work I've had done on my Dodge minivan has been above board. They are very upfront about labor costs. I highly recommend them for maintenance and repair on your vehicles. They won't sell you anything you don't need, the transparency is very nice.

reviews.author: Maria Potts
reviews.text: Such nice people. One of my tires had a nail in it and they patched it up without even charging me. I had been to them once before for a headlight problem, and I’ll definitely be going to them again if I have any car trouble when I’m in the Black Mountain area.

reviews.author: Kevin Hall
reviews.text: The people there are real good people, and they give good service. They hung in there with me. When I was trying to get my truck inspected? And it kept fell in and I would do something to it. And it would feel again then I do something to it and it would fail again. They didn't get mad at me or anything. They just hung in there with me. I got it fixed and I got the inspection. Everything's was good. The girl at the front desk is absolutely beautiful I mean beautiful. Where the ear car needs to work on or not, she's worth going by there.

reviews.author: Elise Brower
reviews.text: I was in black mountian volunteering. Car broke down when I arrived. My AAA towed it. I picked this autoshop at random bc they said they could get it looked at that day. They informed me that diagnostics would be $120 but that it was probably transmission. I elected not to do diagnostics and get a quote for a new transmission. I called daily for updates. A WEEK later I finally get the quote for a new transmission over $8,000. Since this was over the value of the car, I elected to scrap it. They told me scrap price would be $350 but he could offer me $500. I informed him that I had an online offer for 2k. He then asked me to not sell it yet bc he thought he could come up a little in price... I don't think he was going 4-5x his initial offer. I told the receptionist that I went ahead and accepted the offer online and they would get it the next day. Her attitude changed from southern sweet to anger. Way more angry than someone who clocks in and out of a job. Something smells fishy with this place. Seems like they are running scams here.

reviews.author: Amy Ward
reviews.text: Seriously impressed! My husbands truck completely broke down pulling out of our driveway this morning. The gears stopped working. I called BMA, told them what happened, and he said he could look at it the same day. Which was amazing because I did NOT want to go all weekend without a car, also not even knowing how much it was going to be to have it fixed. He set up a wrecker service to come get it for me. The wrecker was here within 30 minutes. Within 2 hours he called to tell me it was the smallest of problems and it was ready to be picked up! I had him actually fix a window issue while it was already there. They had the part on hand, and it was ready a couple hours later. Ashley who runs the front is so kind and efficient. It is VERY hard to find trustworthy spots in the automotive industry. Very. I feel blessed to have utilized their services for the first time today! Please don’t hesitate to do the same. Thanks! Amy

reviews.author: Tiffany Hall
reviews.text: Brenda has always taken care of me!! Black Mountain Automotive is the only shop we use. As a female I feel comfortable with them working on my cars and no they aren't going to take advantage of me. Honest people, great service and prices!!

reviews.author: Jim Taylor
reviews.text: Excellent, honest shop got me back on the road in 2 hours after breaking down on the freeway. Thanks 01' Jeep XJ

reviews.author: Wes Waldorf
reviews.text: Great service and communication. Very fair pricing and have always called to have additional work approved. More than accommodating with my schedule as car repairs are rarely ever planned for. Highly recommend for anything from brakes and oil changes to more severe repairs. Thank you for your services and great communication!

reviews.author: Emmit Clore
reviews.text: The mechanic on schedule took care of my Son's car. I needed a piece added to my Son's car's battery....it took 8 minutes. Exactly - 8 minutes to get the car fixed. I would sincerely recommend this facility to anyone who wants professional and very PROMPT service. AND the ladies? And the Ladies at the front counter were friendly and engaging. Again would recommend this automotive repair shop to anyone. TWO thumbs up!

reviews.author: Jill
reviews.text: I had a slow leak on one of my tires and went in to get a patch repair mid afternoon. It was a busy day. I think I waited maybe 30 minutes and when they finished they told me I did not owe anything. They did the job for free! The staff was very friendly and helpful. Thanks again! I will be back for my next oil change. : )

reviews.author: Liza Cottrell
reviews.text: My husband and I are new to Black Mountain and are thrilled to have a local auto shop we can count on. I took my car in for new breaks, and he took his truck for a problem with 4WD that multiple dealership mechanics couldn't figure out before, and it was fixed in a day. BM Automotive has genuine employees and fast and reliable service. They will continue to be our go-to shop!

reviews.author: Re Naves
reviews.text: Great service. Good staff and prices are reasonable. I'm glad I found them. They have done new tires, brake job, and other maintenance for me. My husband was a mechanic but is no longer able to work on cars. We are thankful to have Black Mountain Automotive.

reviews.author: Tanya Ferry
reviews.text: We were traveling through moving to Wyoming and ended up having car troubles. From when we walked in to all the help we received while we were there… they all made an amazing experience for us! We are very appreciative and grateful for being taken care of being strangers to the area!

reviews.author: Barbara Halpirn
reviews.text: Friendly but seriously inexperienced. Don’t go here to buy tires or have them balanced! Three times to balance new tires they installed and get on the interstate at 70mph bouncing significantly! They claimed that is just the way all terrain tires perform....so not true! Today the manager/owner refused to do anything to address it because he already balanced them for free several times and he makes no money on tires....so tough luck! He also claimed he had a great attorney, if we chose to sue him! We went down the street to WNC Tires where they bought our tires from to see what they could do. They went to balance them and showed us how the tires were wrongly balanced by being over weighted to bring it to zero! Cost us $40 to resolve that I plan on billing Black Mountain Automotive and possibly meeting their attorney. Save yourself the aggravation and go directly to WNC Tires! I wouldn’t trust Black Mountain Automotive with any work on my vehicle.....lack of integrity! I’ve noticed they usually trash any bad reviews and discount them so we’ll see how they choose to be big enough to admit a mistake and apologize with $40. Barbara Halprin

reviews.author: Kevin Greenspan
reviews.text: I had brought my Lexus in to have the motor fixed that controls the hatchback opening and closing and it turns out that they found a switch that was simply off in the glove compartment so did not charge me for the motor repair and then while they were there I had forgotten to mention to them I had smelled some antifreeze and they told me about it and found it needed a water pump and they very economically put that in for me. Very ethical good quality work. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Tiffany Erwin
reviews.text: Highly recommend!!! Go see Barbara at the front desk. Her and her crew will take great care of you! And the 1st place I have been to that has a female mechanic that gives the boys a run for their money! Lol Seriously automotive problems take ur car here. You won't regret it!

reviews.author: Derrick Stikeleather
reviews.text: I had the AC compressor replaced in my car for the second time. First time was done by another shop and took 1 week and 2500 dollars. This time I expected the worst but the repair work only took 1 day (less, really) and was less than half what I paid before. The work was done correctly too which is the most important thing when getting your car repaired. I will use them again.

reviews.author: anita elliott
reviews.text: Barbara rocks. Shes honest, efficient, takes care of everyone and really cares. Always feel taken care of when I bring my car here and never overcharged. Thanks Caleb and gang, you all kill it but really Barbara is the best.

reviews.author: Angela M Stone
reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about Caleb and his staff. Thorough, honest, well versed on every aspect of your car are just the beginning (and I drive a hybrid Prius with over 300k that I have owned for 14 years). The staff are all friendly and do a superb job of explaining and of their own time management as well. A solid place to take your vehicle in every way.

reviews.author: Heidi Chapman
reviews.text: I have been going here for years. I originally found them online because their tires were well priced. I now get all of my tires, oil changes, and brake work there. They are never pushy with sales and treat you right. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ben Shirley
reviews.text: I went in for a state inspection. They very nice and quick. While waiting I saw them help out a Spanish speaking customer. They were patient and really striving to give good service to everyone. Businesses like this are important to have in our community.

reviews.author: Em H
reviews.text: This place has been great to us every time we've gone. We broke down not to far from them and one of their workers (right before closing time) went out of his way to come get our tire, replace it and even put it on for us. We will always go back there from now on and recommend to anyone!

reviews.author: Jacob Dixon
reviews.text: I was heading to Tennessee when I got stranded my car. They were able to get me in quick and diagnose the issue within a hour. I found out I blew a head. They replaced my engine in under 5 working days and was able to get back to my job with no time missed. I highly recommend them for any maintenance issue.

reviews.author: Travis Cagle
reviews.text: Sad. I have been going here for years and this time will be the last. I had a belt and tensioner replaced here. Less than 200 miles later, it is squeaking again. I call and make an 8:30am appointment to drop off my car. I drop my car off the day before so it could be seen bright and early. 6 hours later, and the car is still not touched. I call to check on it and am told thar some tow ins came in. I have the foggiest on how that should impact my scheduled repair. A few hour later I call back and am told that it is one of the mechanics last day and they are "getting the heavy lifting out of the way". Again, not sure why you have people schedule repairs if that goes out of the window. Note, both instances I had to be the one to call them. Nobody bothered to contact me to let me know I may need to find another way to get around this week.

reviews.author: Courtney Ford
reviews.text: Purchased a vehicle end of May 2024 great vehicle and I love it. Downfall is I still don’t have a title and I cannot drive the vehicle it’s setting in my driveway. Getting a call back from them is about impossible.

reviews.author: Tom Sharar
reviews.text: Purchased four Michelin Pilot tires for my wife's SL500 last fall. Beat everyone in town by a couple hundred dollars. Great experience from the time I walked in. Thanks for the good service, and thanks for your service to our country. Additionally, just purchased another set of tires for my Jeep WJ. Still excellent prices and super service. Thanks, Caleb!

reviews.author: Life In The AVL
reviews.text: Came in because my check engine light was on. They took great care of me and was very efficient! Honest and reliable, I will definitely come back when other car problems occur.

reviews.author: Joel Stanley
reviews.text: Was in town for a youth conference when our bus started running rough. Black Mountain Automotive had the problem fixed by the day's end and for a very reasonable price. Staff was friendly and professional. Things were fixed promptly and completely. Will certainly be using them again if the need arises.

reviews.author: Terry Nichols
reviews.text: I go in to get a nail I had found out of my tire. I wait 15 and then my car comes pulling out the garage and down the road so the tps light will go off and they bring it back with air in it and call it fixed. They didn’t have a mask on and hopped right into my personal climate with what ever germs they had came into contact with and also they did not have permission to drive my car. You don’t need a test drive if you do what I ask and revive the nail. That simple job should be done with them never entering and driving my property. The guy at front said the service was free of charge and I got to keep my nail in the tire for a new day.

reviews.author: David Patterson
reviews.text: I am a father of a Montreat College freshman and I love 4 hours away. My son needed to have his tires checked but was challenged by soccer practice finishing after the tire shop would’ve closed. I spoke with Anna, who promised they would stay after hours and take care of my son, and they did! THAT is service and we will definitely bring our business here! D. Patterson

reviews.author: Alex Andrew
reviews.text: Had a terrible experience here and my friend is currently as I’m typing this having their own terrible experience with them. Withheld information to more or less try to make me buy their parts, and on top of that I waited for over 20 minutes to be spoken to while the “secratary” mostly stood there? Don’t turn your sign on and unlock your doors if you aren’t ready for people to come in! Did not let them so much as touch my vehicle. People kept telling me they’re so great. Maybe it’s just cause they are really the only ones around. Just all in all a terrible time. I’d rather give my money to ANYONE else!

reviews.author: Nick Williamson
reviews.text: Had an appointment 8:30 Monday morning to just diagnosis a couple of problems on my truck. Dropped it off the night before. By 3:00pm Monday they hadn't even looked at it yet, so Im going to take it else where. lady at the counter was nice, but they obviously have no idea what they're doing when it comes to scheduling, so just have that in mind.

reviews.author: Brandon Allen
reviews.text: Never had a problem with them. Me, my grandparents, and my wife have been going to them for years. They put my tires on my truck a year and a half ago. I called to see if they would rotate them Friday. The girl told me they dont do tires on trucks as big as mine. I told here they put the tires on the truck. So she asked me to hold for a sec, and then came back, and said they would rotate them on Monday for me. So I show up today, and the guy tells me they wont do it. Said my tires are too big. Told me the girl must not have known. I am not saying there bad, or there work is bad, but if they haven't seen your car dont bet on them honoring there appointments. So if your not close by where there located its probably better to go somewhere else.

reviews.author: Chip Bridges
reviews.text: I've used Black Mountain Automotive several times since they've opened and have had only good experiences. More than once they've done little things at no charge. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Kim Welch
reviews.text: I had a great experience here. The staff was friendly and I have observed the integrity in which Caleb runs this business. He often goes the extra mile for his customers.

reviews.author: Philip Showalter
reviews.text: Very friendly and fast was able to get my matrix in that evening and was ready before 12 the next day, with no appointment (front wheel bearing). They checked the other to make sure it was ok and they stand behind there work.

reviews.author: Simon Carkeek
reviews.text: I was on vacation in Black Mountain and hit a large pothole, badly denting the rim of my wheel. I took it into these guys and they could not have been more friendly and helpful. Within 15 minutes they had sorted my problem and what’s more, at no charge! Thank you - you made my vacation :-)

reviews.author: Andrew Olson
reviews.text: I got a flat tire on my way out of town after vacation. They were very professional and got it patched up in just a few minutes for a very reasonable price. If i'm in town again and need some work done then i'm sure i'll be back.

reviews.author: Don Stikeleather
reviews.text: They installed a rebuilt jasper transmission in our escape. Very professional, and we are well pleased.

reviews.author: Nicole Riley
reviews.text: I had an issue with my tire sensor that I didn't have prior to going there, they fixed it free and without any issues, absolutely wonderful people and best prices in town.

reviews.author: Kimber Rank
reviews.text: I will use this Auto Shop for all of my auto needs... Honesty, integrity, excellent and knowledgeable staff and reasonable prices are rare to find but thankfully I found them at Black Mountain Auto. I am already recommending them to others!

reviews.author: Michael McDermott
reviews.text: Barbara, Ben and the staff did a FABULOUS Job! They got me in the same day, and did everything that was necessary for the repair. Again, overall, they did a fantastic job!

reviews.author: Jessica Greene
reviews.text: Do not i repeat do not get a used transmission from these ppl. I got mine put june 27 they give u 30 days bc they said they dont know what they going to do. Im having issues with mine took it somewhere else they found metal pieces in my transmission fluid. I have messages showing where they said we are putting in your transmission.something along the line of the outside looks good then be good to go.Umm what about the inside of this.Im disabled limited income.only car i have for some machanic to do me dirty like this. No now im stuck with another bad transmission and not even been a year. From june 27 to now.im so mad im seeing red.theres other things that had started happening to my car after they done this as well too.

reviews.author: Jim W
reviews.text: Very friendly and professional staff. First time in the shop, but will definitely be a repeat customer. Had a leaking tire and they repaired it at no charge!

reviews.author: Robert Lacy Ranson
reviews.text: Black Mountain automotive is a good honest group of folks running an honest business. And, I chose them to be my auto repair shop because their main mechanic knows Ford vehicles, because he used to work for Ford. Mostly Black Mountain auto repair takes care of their customers, and everything they do is fair.

reviews.author: Tanya Chavis
reviews.text: The experience, customer service and prices are great! And they actually fixed my car unlike a lot of places, the same day!

reviews.author: Pat Andrews
reviews.text: The staff There Are Very Nice! I like that They Call and Explain to You in detail what Service is Needed For Your car and give You the Price .

reviews.author: Lester Flatt
reviews.text: Talk to the owner. Drove down. They were closed. Business hours posted as being open til 5:00. Owner responded that they left, better get there before 4:00 next time. Good advice for whomever decides to go, it won’t be me.

reviews.author: Ann Groninger
reviews.text: Great service. Very quick and friendly. I'm only in the area occasionally but will make every effort to get repairs done here.

reviews.author: Cherin Marmon-Saxe
reviews.text: Great prices- Quick and great service! So gonvenient ! And my car feels like its floating on air !!! So happy. Thank you !

reviews.author: iMust BeNice
reviews.text: Horrible car service. Did not fix the problem but made it worse. Did not hook up the equipment properly and left me to pay for the mistake they made. I would not recommend or use them again.

reviews.author: M D Hayden
reviews.text: Great mechanic service, honest, caring, excellent customer service. They go above and beyond to look out for the customer.

reviews.author: Rosalyn Palyszeski (rozziemarie)
reviews.text: Great job, no one wears masks and cant get Goodyear or Douglas tires which is a Subsidiary of Goodyear.

reviews.author: evan wade
reviews.text: Fast, professional and reasonably priced. These are my folks when I'm in this neck of the woods now.

reviews.author: carol mclane
reviews.text: These people know what they are doing..barb in the front is cheerful ..wonderful w customers. Good prices
